task_description.overview: Fetch an earthquake event from a remote QuakeML source, extract its origin and focal mechanism, and plot the beachball on a global map.
steps: Download QuakeML event data via obspy.read_events() from the provided URL.
Extract the preferred origin or fallback to the first origin for latitude and longitude.
Extract the preferred focal mechanism or fallback to the first mechanism and retrieve its moment tensor components.
Configure a PlateCarree global map centered at 0° with extent [-180,180,-90,90], add coastlines and gridlines.
Transform the event origin lon/lat to projection coordinates.
Plot the beachball using the moment tensor list at the transformed coordinates, adjust width and transparency.

task_definition.agent_prompt:
Read the earthquake event from {quakeml_url} using obspy.read_events. Extract the event origin and moment tensor components. Create a global PlateCarree map centered at {projection_central_longitude}°, add coastlines and gridlines. Transform the event location coordinates to projection space and plot a beachball with the extracted tensor values and projected position. 
 Note: 1) Save the beachball plot to {result_plot}.
